summary: W.W. Grainger filed a preliminary Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for an offering of senior notes due 20XX, with principal amount, coupon and maturity left blank in the preliminary document. Interest is payable semi-annually beginning 2027; notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking pari passu with existing senior unsecured debt and carry a change-of-control put. Joint book-running managers are J.P. Morgan, U.S. Bancorp and Wells Fargo Securities. This is a routine investment-grade debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; proceeds use is not yet specified. Watch pricing spreads and any leverage impact.
